harness_rules: Prefer a qualification-only JavaScript harness under .github/scripts; do not add a new runtime facade unless an actual composition impossibility is proven first.
The harness may construct synthetic fixtures and sequentially call existing public APIs, but may not add hidden authority logic to compensate for a failing predecessor boundary.
If an existing public API cannot support a required valid composition, stop and classify the exact interface gap before changing production code.
All synthetic author/provider/publication fixtures must carry explicit synthetic markers and the evidence summary must say they are not human evidence or production authorization.
A hosted PASS is prequalification only; final E2E closure requires a newly registered exact-SHA A-01 run for BOOK-SYSTEM-END-TO-END-AUTHORING-QUALIFICATION-001.
Any changed harness/wrapper/fixture bytes after hosted PASS require a fresh hosted exact-SHA PASS before A-01.

research_gate.reason: This objective introduces no new publishing, provenance, editorial, human-decision or lifecycle semantics. Current research-verified contracts are already bound; the remaining question is executable composition of existing qualified repository authorities.
